Salesforce Email Template Builder

Generate on-brand, Outlook-safe Salesforce email templates in six ready-made formats.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Builds STA's customer- and staff-facing Salesforce Lightning email templates as paste-ready HTML. You pick (or describe) one of six formats; the skill produces the body to drop into the Salesforce template editor, a suggested subject line, and the list of merge fields it used. Every template comes out using only STA's three brand colors, with personalization as merge fields (never a hardcoded name), a first-name sign-off, and table-based HTML built to survive both classic Outlook and Salesforce's HTML sanitizer.

When to use it

Any time you need a Salesforce / Lightning email template or a support or customer email for STA - a case reply, a how-to, a case acknowledgement, a meeting request, a bulk announcement, or an internal alert - instead of hand-writing email HTML.

How to trigger it

"make a Salesforce email template"

"draft a support email template"

"create a case reply template"

"build a bulk notification email"

"Lightning email template"

The six formats

Live previews of each format below (dummy content shown; the real templates use merge fields):

1 Short Case Reply

A quick, direct reply on a case - a quote, an answer, or a follow-up. Greeting, one to three short paragraphs that lead with the deliverable, then a sign-off. No letterhead.

2 Step-by-Step Instructions

Walks a customer through a procedure as numbered steps with bold UI labels and a link to the full guide. Leads with the outcome so they know why they are doing it.

3 Case Acknowledgement

The automatic email that confirms a case was created. Includes a clean Case Number / Subject / What-you-told-us summary block and tells the customer they can just reply to add information.

4 Meeting Request

Asks the customer to book time (a screen-share or call), gives a reason it is worth it, and offers a booking link plus a reply-with-windows fallback.

5 Bulk Notification

A product or announcement email sent to a customer list - an end-of-life notice, a release, or a new feature. Branded 600px layout with a headline, bullet list, and a deep link. Uses the Opt-out (No Logo) letterhead for the unsubscribe.

6 Internal Notification

A staff-facing triage alert (for example, a new web case). Leads with the priority, lays out the key case fields, and links straight to the case in Salesforce. Internal only - no marketing footer.

Good to know

Templates use only STA's three brand colors and are checked for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. The last step before going live is always a real Salesforce test send opened in Outlook and Gmail - Salesforce rewrites HTML on save, so the delivered email must be eyeballed once, not trusted from the paste.
